title: Simplicial model structure on an undercategory
statement:
Use the model-category, simplicial tensor, cotensor and enriched mapping-set conventions of [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization]. Let $\mathcal M$ be a simplicial model category and let $A\in\mathcal M$ be any object, not necessarily cofibrant. The ordinary undercategory $\mathcal M_{A/}$ has objects arrows $a:A\to X$ and morphisms $a\to b$ arrows $h:X\to Y$ satisfying $ha=b$. It admits a simplicial model structure in which a morphism is a weak equivalence, cofibration or fibration exactly when its underlying arrow in $\mathcal M$ is one. Its initial object is $1_A:A\to A$ and its terminal object is $A\to1$, where $1$ is terminal in $\mathcal M$. Thus $a:A\to X$ is cofibrant as an object of $\mathcal M_{A/}$ exactly when $a$ is a cofibration, and is fibrant exactly when $X$ is fibrant in $\mathcal M$. For $a:A\to X$ and $b:A\to Y$, its enriched mapping simplicial set is the degreewise pullback
$$\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathcal M_{A/}}(a,b)=\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathcal M}(X,Y)\times_{\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathcal M}(A,Y)}\{b\},$$
where the first map is precomposition with $a$ and $\{b\}:=\Delta^0\to\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathcal M}(A,Y)$ is the vertex $b$. Its tensor of $a$ by a simplicial set $K$ is $A\to A\amalg_{A\otimes K}(X\otimes K)$, using $A\otimes K\to A$ induced by $K\to\Delta^0$; its cotensor of $b$ by $K$ is $A\to Y^K$, induced from $b$ by the constant-$K$ map $Y\to Y^K$. No properness or combinatorial hypothesis is required.
